scope: 0119 bent-sheet part, sequential thermo-mechanical build on a 2 mm raft, flash reading A' inherited from v2-cube-rs
purpose: Real-part transfer of the cube-stress production contract (cube-stress-production-dwellflash.json). Geometry-specific quantities (layer count, per-layer area, scan time, energy, capture fraction, release box) are derived from the HEX8 mesh so that swapping the mesh only re-runs the preflight. Process parameters are the Balbaa 140 W condition until the real machine settings are supplied.

mesh.note: graded route-A mesh (4 x 0.2 mm cells across the 0.8 mm sheet, coarse foot/lugs, 2.4 mm along the wall); raft 1 mm = fixture band (--support-thickness) and release cut box; every cell spans exactly one 0.2 mm layer (mesh_check/check_hex_layers.py PASS)

layer_schedule.activation_rule: activate a 200 um slab when its first contained 40 um physical-layer flash starts

scan.scan_time_rule: t_scan(layer) = A(slab) / (hatch x speed): full-area hatching, contours and jumps excluded

flash.power_rule: commanded(layer) = P x t_scan(layer) / (t_flash x capture(slab))
flash.note: reading A' (D-V2-11): the whole physical layer's energy P x t_scan is flashed in the cell dwell time 0.2 mm / 650 mm/s, then laser-off hold sub-steps span the rest of t_scan. The legacy Gaussian exp(-2 rho^2/r^2) with r = 1 m over a 96 mm part drops 1.0 % centre-to-corner; capture(slab) is evaluated on the mesh (sum over the slab's cells of A_cell x exp(-2 rho^2/r^2) x 2/(pi r^2)), so deposited energy per layer equals Ac x P x t_scan(layer) by construction and the ledger measures it.

thermal_mechanical.release_rule: raft cells cut (stiffness and locked-in stress removed) + 3-point rigid-body anchors on printed nodes; bottom Dirichlet temperature held at the preheat value through cooldown

runner.heat_source_note: depth band identical to the cube contract (vertex-collocated lumped source, discrete band integral = 1 for a 0.2 mm cell); the in-plane radius is overridden by scan.flash.beam_radius_m

mechanics.note: 22 rows per physical layer (2 flash + 10 hold + 10 recoat); one mechanics solve per physical layer as in the cube production run
